title: Adventure Time
synopsis: Young Finn and his shape-shifting dog buddy, Jake, go on a series of surreal adventures as they journey through the postapocalyptic Land of Ooo.

bonus.title: Theme Song | Adventure Time | Cartoon Network

episodes.title: Slumber Party Panic
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Princess Bubblegum must protect the Candy Kingdom from a horde of candy zombies they accidentally created.

episodes.title: Trouble in Lumpy Space
episodes.synopsis: Finn must travel to Lumpy Space to find a cure that will save Jake, who was accidentally bitten by Lumpy Space Princess at a tea party.

episodes.title: Prisoners of Love
episodes.synopsis: When the Ice King kidnaps a number of princesses he sees as potential brides, Finn and Jake team with the prisoners to set everybody free.

episodes.title: Tree Trunks
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake join Tree Trunks in search for the rare Crystal Gem Apple, but question whether Tree Trunks has what it takes to adventure.

episodes.title: The Enchiridion!
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake go on a quest for a magical book that would prove them worthy of being righteous heroes.

episodes.title: The Jiggler
episodes.synopsis: A jiggly creature attracted by Finn's auto-tuned singing follows Finn and Jake home but soon feels ill effects of separation from its family.

episodes.title: Ricardio the Heart Guy
episodes.synopsis: When a Heart Guy named Ricardio comes to Candy Kingdom, Finn gets really jealous and finds a way to get him out of the Land of Ooo.

episodes.title: Business Time
episodes.synopsis: When Finn and Jake discover a group of businessmen frozen in an iceberg, the duo thaws them and hires them to help with their adventures.

episodes.title: My Two Favorite People
episodes.synopsis: Jake's plan to spend time with both Lady Rainicorn and Finn backfires.

episodes.title: Memories of Boom Boom Mountain
episodes.synopsis: Finn reflects on an upsetting experience in his past and pledges to help everyone in town, but this proves more difficult than imagined.

episodes.title: Wizard
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake temporarily get magic powers from an evil wizard, but are tricked into helping stop a comet.

episodes.title: Evicted!
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake search the land of Ooo for a new home after Marceline claims the duo's treehouse as her own.

episodes.title: It Came from the Nightosphere
episodes.synopsis: Marceline's evil father goes on a soul-sucking rampage after Finn and Marceline accidentally release him from the Nightosphere.

episodes.title: The Eyes
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake try to rid themselves of a weird horse that creeps them out.

episodes.title: Loyalty to the King
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake are excited to meet the Nice King who has come to Ooo. They soon realize that he looks suspiciously like someone else they know; the Ice King.

episodes.title: Blood Under the Skin
episodes.synopsis: When Finn gets a splinter on his finger, he wants to get the best armor. In order to receive it, he must go on a quest to get the Magical Armor of Zelderon and survive one embarrassing situation after another.

episodes.title: Storytelling
episodes.synopsis: Jake is sick and demands to hear a good story full of romance, fighting and suspense.

episodes.title: Slow Love
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake agree to help a snail named Snorlock find a girlfriend.

episodes.title: Power Animal
episodes.synopsis: Finn is captured by gnomes who want to use his energy to power their infernal machines, and it's up to Jake to stay focused and rescue him.

episodes.title: Crystals Have Power
episodes.synopsis: Jake takes a pledge of nonviolence just before Finn is kidnapped by outlaws from the crystalline dimension.

episodes.title: The Other Tarts
episodes.synopsis: Finn choses to cross the Desert of Doom to deliver the royal tarts to the annual back rubbing ceremony.

episodes.title: To Cut a Woman's Hair
episodes.synopsis: A tree witch demands a lock of princess hair or else Jake will be sucked into her bottomless bottom.

episodes.title: The Chamber of Frozen Blades
episodes.synopsis: Whilst the Ice King goes out to take Gunther to the hospital, Finn and Jake decide to sneak inside his lair and flex their ninja skills.

episodes.title: Her Parents
episodes.synopsis: Jake's relationship with Lady Rainicorn is in danger when he promises to meet with her parents, as both species had a long history of war with each other. However, thanks to Jake's shape-shifting powers, they mistake the dog as one of their own, but for how long?

episodes.title: Conquest of Cuteness
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake must defend their home from the Cuties, a tiny race who believe themselves to be evil, destructive invaders.

episodes.title: Morituri te Salutamus
episodes.synopsis: The duo choose to partake in gladiatorial combat against the Fight King's ghost warriors, but Finn succumbs to bloodlust while Jake becomes obsessed in keeping a cool morale.

episodes.title: Memory of a Memory
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake enter Marceline's mind to awaken her from a sleep spell she had cast on herself, without knowing that they are being tricked by a person from her past.

episodes.title: Hitman
episodes.synopsis: The grounded Ice King hires a fire-manipulating hitman to attack Finn and Jake, without realizing the potentially deadly consequences.

episodes.title: Too Young
episodes.synopsis: The Earl of Lemongrab takes over the Candy Kingdom due to Princess Bubblegum's age regression, forcing her and Finn to try and get rid of him even if it means a life-altering decision.

episodes.title: The Monster
episodes.synopsis: The king and queen of Lumpy Space ask Finn and Jake to bring their daughter back home. At the same time, they attempt to stop a "monster" from destroying a village.

episodes.title: Still
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake are literally unable to move and are at the mercy of the Ice King.

episodes.title: Wizard Battle
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake enter a competition for wizards in disguise so they can prevent Ice King from winning the grand prize: a kiss from Princess Bubblegum.

episodes.title: Fionna and Cake
episodes.synopsis: In this gender-swapped episode, Fionna and Cake must battle the evil Ice Queen.

episodes.title: What Was Missing
episodes.synopsis: Finn and his friends must come together as a genuine band in order to open the gate of the Door Lord and get back their taken items.

episodes.title: Apple Thief
episodes.synopsis: When Tree Trunks's apples go missing, she, Finn and Jake descend into the dark side of the Candy Kingdom in order to find the thief.

episodes.title: The Creeps
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake receive an invitation to a masquerade dinner. It turns into a whodunit as guests start to meet their demise.

episodes.title: Hot to the Touch
episodes.synopsis: Finn develops a crush on Flame Princess and tries to get to know her, which proves difficult due to her destructive power.

episodes.title: Five Short Graybles
episodes.synopsis: Follow as 5 stories intertwine together, can you find the connection?

episodes.title: Web Weirdos
episodes.synopsis: When Finn gets trapped in a giant spider web, he ends up playing marriage counselor to a couple of grumpy arachnids.

episodes.title: Dream of Love
episodes.synopsis: Tree Trunks is courted by an oinking suitor, but much to Jake’s dismay, this interferes with her baking habits.

episodes.title: Return to the Nightosphere
episodes.synopsis: Marceline’s dad banishes Finn and Jake to the Nightosphere, and it stinks. Literally.

episodes.title: Daddy's Little Monster
episodes.synopsis: Finn and Jake attempt to rescue Marceline and find out what's making her behave so strangely.

episodes.title: In Your Footsteps
episodes.synopsis: A bear cozies up to the guys, but his true intentions may be hidden.

episodes.title: Hug Wolf
episodes.synopsis: Finn goes through a transformation after a run-in with a hug wolf.

episodes.title: Princess Monster Wife
episodes.synopsis: Princesses lose body parts under mysterious circumstances.

episodes.title: Goliad
episodes.synopsis: Battling with her new realization of her own mortality, in a sleep deprived state Princess bubblegum creates her own heir to the throne. After meeting the heir, Finn and Jake decide to teach her the ways of the world.

episodes.title: Beyond This Earthly Realm
episodes.synopsis: When Finn finds a porcelain lamb, it transports him into the spirit world and only the Ice King can help get him out.

episodes.title: Gotcha!
episodes.synopsis: In order to do research for her tell-all memoir about men, Lumpy Space Princess goes undercover working for Finn and Jake.

episodes.title: Finn the Human
episodes.synopsis: Part 2 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

episodes.title: Jake the Dog
episodes.synopsis: Part 3 of a three-part episode. Finn and Jake chase the Lich through a dimensional portal and meet a wishmaster. After the Lich wishes that humanity never existed, Finn wishes that the Lich never existed.

episodes.title: Five More Short Graybles
episodes.synopsis: A series of short stories all centered around a common theme, hosted by a mysterious man named Cuber from the future.

episodes.title: Up a Tree
episodes.synopsis: The guys' game of catch goes awry when their throwing disc is lodged in a large tree.

episodes.title: All the Little People
episodes.synopsis: Finn receives a bag full of miniature versions of his friends.

episodes.title: Jake the Dad
episodes.synopsis: Jake's a daddy, but being a father and keeping his rainicorn pups from killing themselves or each other is a lot harder than he imagined.

episodes.title: Davey
episodes.synopsis: Finn creates an alter ego, Davey. Davey soon begins to take over, and Jake is forced into action to get his old friend back.

episodes.title: Mystery Dungeon
episodes.synopsis: Ice King, NEPTR, Tree Trunks, Shelby, and Lemongrab are trapped inside a mysterious dungeon and must work together to free themselves.

episodes.title: All Your Fault
episodes.synopsis: Princess Bubblegum sends Finn and Jake to investigate a message of distress from the Earls of Lemongrab.

episodes.title: Little Dude
episodes.synopsis: Finn's hat comes to life and becomes evil after it is touched by a wizard. Finn, Jake, and the wizard track the hat down, and manage to turn the hat good.

episodes.title: Bad Little Boy
episodes.synopsis: The princesses tire of Ice King’s crazy Fionna-and-Cake fan-fiction stories, so Marceline stops by the Ice Kingdom to show him how to properly write a story.

episodes.title: Vault of Bones
episodes.synopsis: When Flame Princess begins to doubt her evilness, Finn insists she is not evil and takes her on a journey into a dungeon to help her sort out her thoughts.
